article.title: Procedure of Board for Advance Rulings.
article.content:
388Procedure of Board for Advance Rulings.

Section 388  ·  Chapter XVIII  ·  D.—Alternate Dispute Resolutions — 2.—Advance rulings  ·  page 455 of the Act
The Board for Advance Rulings shall, subject to the provisions of this Chapter, have power to regulate its own procedure in all matters arising out of the exercise of its powers under this Act.
